proposal.risk_audit: All 3 checked dimensionless (L^aT^b balance) with strictly positive denominators (omega*k, eps, omega*d+sqrt(k)) so finite 100% except wall d=0 bounded by construction; no Umag/Snorm/Wnorm in denominators to avoid zero-division; orthogonal to I1/I2 (APG work, Pk/eps non-equilibrium, wall proximity) to target bump/diffuser separation; monotonic mappings preserve ordering, low overfit risk as each is single-ratio physics sensor.

features.name: f_apg
features.rationale: Signed APG work vs turbulence scale; >0 marks adverse pressure gradient driving bump/diffuser separation where SST fails.

features.name: f_noneq
features.rationale: Production-to-dissipation ratio marking non-equilibrium shear/separation and reattachment where eddy-viscosity lags.

features.name: f_wall
features.rationale: Bounded wall-proximity sensor (~sqrt(k)/(omega*d)); distinguishes near-wall vs free-shear where SST anisotropy error differs.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 formulas unit-checked L-T: gradp/(omega*sqrtk)= (L/T2)/(L/T2), DUDt/(omega*Umag)=(L/T2)/(L/T2), (W-S)/(W+S+omega)=(1/T)/(1/T) so dimensionless under velocity/length rescaling. Finite: f_rots denom W+S+omega>0 always finite; f_pgrad/f_accel infinite only where sqrtk=0/Umag=0 (wall-adjacent), same pattern as accepted f_apg, expected <1% non-finite. Not constant: all vary separation vs throat vs freestream. Redundancy: f_rots overlaps I1/I2 partly but adds omega-damped sign; f_pgrad/f_accel add pressure and material-acceleration info missing from I1/I2/Pk-eps. Overfit risk low: monotonic orderings, median-normalized.

features.name: f_pgrad
features.rationale: Pressure-gradient magnitude vs turbulent acceleration scale; locates APG separation onset/reattachment in diffuser and bumps where SST anisotropy fails.

features.name: f_accel
features.rationale: Mean acceleration vs turbulence frequency; marks converging throat acceleration and bump curvature rapid-distortion zones.

features.name: f_rots
features.rationale: Omega-damped rotation-minus-strain sensor; distinguishes recirculation/curvature (rotation) from attached shear where T2/T3 corrections differ.

proposal.risk_audit: All three are dimensionless under V->2V L->3L: UgradP*d/(k*Umag)=(L2/T3*L)/(L2/T2*L/T), sqrt(k)/(omega*d)=(L/T)/(L/T), tau_dev/k=(L2/T2)/(L2/T2). Finite risk: 0/0 only where k=0 or Umag=0 exactly at wall/stagnation; training cell-centers have k>0, Umag>0 except <1% points so >99% finite expected, median scaling bounds outliers. Collinearity low: signed APG complements f_pgrad magnitude, wall ratio complements f_rots/f_accel, anisotropy intensity complements f_noneq production ratio. Dropping zero-gain unused features avoids slot waste without harming best formula.

features.name: f_apg
features.rationale: Signed APG vs kinetic-energy advection with wall weighting; positive marks near-wall adverse-gradient separation/reattachment where SST anisotropy fails.

features.name: f_wdist
features.rationale: Turbulent length scale over wall distance; separates near-wall attached shear from free-shear/recirculation for localized T2/T3 correction.

features.name: f_aniso
features.rationale: Baseline anisotropy magnitude relative to k; marks where SST stress shape error is large and correction magnitude should grow.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 dimensionless by L/T scaling: (1/T)/(1/T), (L/T)/(L/T), (L/T2)/(L/T2). f_curv denominator W+S+omega>0 always finite 100%; f_sep and f_pmag singular only at wall k=0/Umag=d=0, expected <1% points like accepted f_apg, interior finite. None constant: curvature changes sign, sep varies throat vs bubble, pmag varies FPG/APG. f_sep partly correlated with f_wdist but adds Umag deficit for bubble vs near-wall; f_pmag magnitude complements dropped signed f_apg; f_curv new rotation-vs-strain info absent. Drop only zero-term zero-gain f_apg/f_aniso; keep f_wdist despite -0.0005 as active T1 term to avoid destabilizing best.

features.name: f_curv
features.rationale: Bounded rotation-minus-strain marks curvature and recirculation where rotation dominates vs attached strain-dominated shear.

features.name: f_sep
features.rationale: Regularized turbulence intensity marking low-velocity separation bubble vs high-speed throat and attached flow.

features.name: f_pmag
features.rationale: Pressure-force magnitude vs turbulent stress marks strong APG/FPG in diffuser and bump throat where SST anisotropy fails.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 proposed features checked dimensionless (L-T): UgradP, UgradK, Pk, eps, omega*k share L2/T3; tau_dev,k share L2/T2. Denominators >0 in interior (eps>0, k>0, tau_dev>=0); only exact wall 0/0 possible on <1% points like accepted f_noneq=Pk/eps. No duplication of I1/I2 strain-rotation magnitude or existing f_noneq/f_accel/f_sep ordering: signed APG power, k-advection vs local source, and baseline anisotropy intensity are orthogonal primitives (UgradP, UgradK, tau_dev unused). Bounded/monotonic mapping preserves APG-vs-FPG and transport sign ordering. Risk: APG and advection correlate in diffuser bubble; mitigated by distinct normalization and by dropping 3 zero-gain features to limit search nodes.

features.name: f_apg
features.rationale: Signed APG power vs turbulence scale; positive marks APG deceleration/separation, negative marks FPG acceleration/throat.

features.name: f_adv
features.rationale: Advection of k vs local production/dissipation; marks non-local history and reattachment where transport dominates equilibrium.

features.name: f_stress
features.rationale: Bounded baseline anisotropy intensity; localizes shear layers and recirculation vs freestream for T2/T3 correction.
